dataset_title: BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems
acquisition_method: Connected GitHub github_fetch_blob returns authoritative UTF-8 content by Git blob SHA; full content processed programmatically without model transcription.
raw_retention_note: Full raw CSV was fetched into tool orchestration memory and aggregated directly; remote immutable source blob + SHA256 retained. Reacquire via GitHub blob or ordinary public download and run prepare_burstgpt.py to reproduce.
attribution: Yuxin Wang et al., BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems, KDD 2025, DOI 10.1145/3711896.3737413.
native_time_unit: seconds from local first-day midnight; absolute date/timezone not supplied in CSV
timestamp_semantics: Request submission, not completion or billing time
transformation: All source rows retained for parsing and full-source QA; input+output sums grouped by floor(timestamp/3600). Canonical target total_tokens across all models/logtypes. Exclude first and last bins containing trace bounds; keep complete interior [3600,5266800). Fill 36 empty interior bins zero under observed-release coverage assumption. No scaling, resampling, detrending, currency conversion, fabricated team/user assignment or shifted calendar dates.
target_semantics: Ultimately recorded request input+output tokens assigned to submission-time bin; serving workload proxy, not financial spending
coverage_assumption: IDEALIZED: trace release is treated as observed request stream throughout interior span; no per-bin provider completeness/outage metadata supplied. Empty bins describe no recorded requests, not verified no real demand.
availability_assumption: IDEALIZED: preceding bins treated as observed at origin. Raw data has no collection/receipt/maturity or completion timestamps; eventually recorded output length can include requests still in flight at origin. Historical online information availability cannot be established.
privacy_identity: No users, teams, projects, accounts, organizations or sessions in actual source CSV. Model+Log Type cohorts are workload cohorts only. Newer README mentions Session ID and Elapsed time but those columns are absent from immutable /data asset used here.
failure_handling: 25,443 rows with zero response tokens retained; authors identify these as failures, which may still involve input usage and do not establish billing treatment.
seasonality_prior: Pinned README labels daily and weekly periodicity figures; fixed 24-bin daily seasonal-naive comparator may be declared before final evaluation, without choosing lag on final outcomes.
limitations: One anonymized Azure-backed workload stream; not representative enterprise team spend or prospective accuracy.
Single fixed hindsight export cannot validate the production bitemporal ingestion gates.
Hourly horizons are1hour/4hours; do not relabel bins as days or claim weekly/monthly planning performance.
No provider-reported monetary target or actual model deployment version; coarse ChatGPT/GPT-4 names cannot establish historical tariff.
Pretrained model may have trained on public historical trace; contamination cannot be ruled out without model training provenance.
